title: Process-Supervised Reinforcement Learning for Interactive Multimodal Tool-Use Agents
authors_zh: Weiting Tan, Xinghua Qu, Ming Tu, Meng Ge, Andy T. Liu, Philipp Koehn, Lu Lu
paper_type_zh: 交互式多模态工具使用强化学习与轨迹奖励研究
best_for_zh: 研究智能体强化学习、轨迹奖励、语音工具使用和 verifier 审计的读者
one_line: Each 1-30-turn retail sandbox rollout carries interleaved agent/environment tokens, GPT-4.1 turn scores, and a rule-verified terminal outcome, but the promised sandbox, tasks, rollouts, and checkpoints are not linked as released artifacts.
TARL 为约3,000个零售任务的文本与语音工具使用 rollout 组合规则终局奖励和 GPT-4.1 逐轮评分，但稳定训练实际优化聚合后的轨迹标量，且论文承诺的 sandbox、任务、rollout 与 checkpoint 尚无已核验发布。
why: It makes a subtle supervision boundary auditable: fine-grained judge labels are generated per turn, yet the stable optimizer consumes a full-episode scalar. That distinction matters when comparing process supervision, reward shaping, and replayable agent-trajectory data.
inclusion_reason: The paper exposes a concrete long-horizon agent data contract: online interleaved policy/environment trajectories, executable MCP-backed state changes, a rule-based terminal predicate, GPT-4.1 turn adjudication, and an aggregated scalar used for agentic RL. It is especially useful for distinguishing process-label provenance from the coarser trajectory-level reward actually optimized.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary source is arXiv:2509.14480 v1, first submitted on 17 September 2025. The official OpenReview record says “Submitted to ICLR 2026”; it does not establish acceptance or proceedings publication. The paper asks how to train an interactive tool-use policy when a binary terminal outcome is too sparse to identify which conversational turn caused success or failure, especially when user responses may be speech rather than text (paper §1; §2.2; OpenReview record).

Its experimental substrate is a retail sandbox derived from tau-bench. One online episode is tau=(x1,e1,...,xT,eT): agent token sequences contain reasoning and tool calls, while environment sequences contain tool results or simulated-user responses, with speech tokens or placeholders in multimodal episodes. A rollout stops when the user simulator emits ##STOP## or after 30 interaction steps. About 3,000 synthetic retail tasks supply a user-simulator instruction and ground-truth tool calls (paper §2.2; §4.1; Appendix “Training Data”).

This belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because the trainable object is an executable, state-changing episode rather than a static answer. It does not claim a released preference dataset, and it does not solve general multimodal perception: speech is used for user turns inside a tool-use workflow. The Card is content-complete for L4 review from the full paper and appendix, but the promised sandbox, tasks, rollouts, and checkpoints were not found as released paper-specific artifacts; direct training reuse therefore remains blocked.

本卡的主要来源是2025年9月17日首次提交的arXiv:2509.14480 v1。OpenReview官方记录写明“Submitted to ICLR 2026”，但不能据此认定论文已被接收或收入proceedings。论文关注的问题是：当二元终局结果过于稀疏，无法指出交互中哪一轮导致成功或失败时，如何训练工具使用policy；用户回复为语音而非文本时，这一问题同样存在（论文§1、§2.2；OpenReview记录）。

实验载体是从tau-bench派生的零售sandbox。一个在线episode写作tau=(x1,e1,...,xT,eT)：agent token序列包含推理与tool call，environment序列包含工具结果或模拟用户回复；多模态episode还包含speech token或placeholder。user simulator发出##STOP##或交互达到30轮时，rollout终止。约3,000个合成零售任务分别提供user simulator指令与ground-truth tool call（论文§2.2、§4.1；附录“Training Data”）。

该工作属于environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为可训练对象是能够改变环境状态的可执行episode，而不是静态答案。它没有声称发布preference dataset，也不解决一般多模态感知；语音仅用于工具使用工作流中的用户轮次。依据论文全文与附录，本卡正文已具备L4人工审阅所需内容，但论文承诺的sandbox、任务、rollout与checkpoint未找到已发布的论文专属artifact，因此直接训练复用仍然blocked。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is Turn-level Adjudicated Reinforcement Learning (TARL): combine a rule-verified terminal outcome with GPT-4.1 judgments attached to individual interaction turns, then aggregate both sources into the scalar used by GRPO or PPO (paper §3.2).

The data and feedback object joins the policy, hidden user-task instruction, ground-truth function-call trajectory, full labeled conversation, per-turn judge scores, terminal verifier result, and final trajectory reward. GPT-4.1 assigns each turn -1, 0, or 1: -1 marks the primary major deviation and may occur at most once per trajectory, 0 marks an issue or downstream by-product, and 1 marks a correct turn. The terminal verifier returns 1 only when the required successful database-changing calls and their arguments completely match the ground truth; otherwise it returns 0 (paper §2.1; §3.2; Appendix “LLM Judge Setup for Turn-Level Evaluation”).

The feedback contract is mixed. The rule verifier observes successful database writes and argument equality, but the phrasing-sensitive expected-output check from tau-bench is excluded from primary RL and evaluation. The judge observes task intent, ground-truth calls, policy identity, and the complete conversation, but its score is model judgment rather than a programmatic proof. TARL retains the process provenance of these labels, yet the stable variant aggregates them into one episode score applied uniformly to policy tokens while masking environment tokens (paper §2.1; §2.2; §3.2; §5.1).

Compared with terminal-only tau-bench RL, TARL adds localized adjudication; compared with direct per-turn reward placement, it deliberately returns to trajectory-level credit because direct placement was unstable. Read it alongside verltool-holistic-agentic-rl-with-tool-use-2025 for broader agentic-RL tooling, while keeping this paper's distinctive turn-judge/terminal-rule contract separate.

论文的贡献是Turn-level Adjudicated Reinforcement Learning（TARL）：把规则验证的终局结果与GPT-4.1附着在各交互轮次上的判断结合起来，再将两类信号聚合为GRPO或PPO实际使用的标量（论文§3.2）。

数据与反馈对象把policy、隐藏的用户任务指令、ground-truth function-call trajectory、完整带标签对话、逐轮judge分数、terminal verifier结果和最终trajectory reward连接起来。GPT-4.1为每轮给出-1、0或1：-1表示主要重大偏离，每条trajectory最多出现一次；0表示问题或后续连带错误；1表示该轮正确。terminal verifier仅在必要的数据库写操作及其参数与ground truth完全匹配时返回1，否则返回0（论文§2.1、§3.2；附录“LLM Judge Setup for Turn-Level Evaluation”）。

这是一个mixed feedback contract。规则verifier观察成功的数据库写操作和参数相等性，但主要RL与评测排除了tau-bench中对措辞敏感的expected-output check。judge可以观察任务意图、ground-truth call、policy身份和完整对话，但其评分属于模型判断，并非程序化证明。TARL保留了这些label的process来源；然而稳定版本把它们聚合成一个episode分数，对policy token统一赋值，同时mask environment token（论文§2.1、§2.2、§3.2、§5.1）。

相较只使用tau-bench终局信号的RL，TARL增加了局部adjudication；相较直接逐轮放置reward，它又因直接放置不稳定而回到trajectory-level credit。可与verltool-holistic-agentic-rl-with-tool-use-2025一起阅读，以了解更广泛的agentic RL工具，但应单独保留本文特有的turn judge与terminal rule组合契约。

title: Method
方法
html:
Construction begins with APIGen-MT conversations. GPT-4.1 infers a user specification and ground-truth tool calls; for retail, the synthesized instruction and a harder rewrite are chosen with 50/50 probability. The resulting training set contains about 3,000 retail tasks. Mixed-task RL also selects medium-difficulty DeepScaleR problems with integer answers, after the authors considered GSM8K, DeepScaleR, and DAPO-MATH-17K. Exact task IDs, stage-by-stage retained counts, and the DeepScaleR sample count are unknown (paper §3.1; §4.1; Appendix “Training Data”).

The sandbox starts from tau-bench seed data in a SQLite backend with Products, Orders, and Users. REST endpoints are registered as MCP tools. A GPT-4 ReAct user simulator produces text turns; SeedTTS converts those turns to audio for speech episodes. The agent alternates reasoning/tool-call sequences with user or tool observations until ##STOP## or the 30-turn cap (paper §2.1, Fig. 2; §2.2).

The rule-based terminal verifier inspects successful write operations and compares tool-call arguments with ground-truth annotations. Complete match yields R(tau)=1; any mismatch yields 0. TARL then asks GPT-4.1 to score every turn from the policy, task instruction, ground-truth calls, and complete labeled conversation. Terminal success is weighted 10×, the single major -1 is weighted 5×, and the remaining turn scores use 1/T normalization so the positive process contribution is capped at 5. The paper groups totals as perfect 15, good 10–15, good-attempt 0–5, and failed -5–0 (paper §3.2; Appendix judge prompt).

Qwen3-8B is the text policy. Text training alternates retail and DeepScaleR math tasks. Qwen2.5-Omni-7B is the speech-capable policy; instead of SFT, it first receives 30 GRPO warm-up steps on simplified tasks with more explicit instructions, then alternates math, text-only retail, and retail with speech user responses. Batch size is 128, formed from 32 tasks and four rollouts each. The reported settings include temperature 0.7, top-p 0.95, prompt length 4096, response length 1024, actor learning rate 1e-6, critic learning rate 1e-5, and training that usually plateaus after 200–300 steps (paper §4.1; §4.3; Appendix “Training Details,” Table tab:hyperparameters).

Training uses verl and RL-Factory with GRPO, PPO, and RLOO comparisons. Directly placing turn rewards on each turn's final token destabilized PPO; the best variant sums TARL into a trajectory reward and assigns it across policy tokens, masking environment tokens. Reproduction must pin the SQLite seed/database state, REST and MCP schemas, GPT-4/GPT-4.1 and SeedTTS versions, prompts, split manifests, random seeds, and rollout retention. None of those paper-specific implementation artifacts is currently linked as a release (paper §2.2; §3.2; §5.1; paper.tex commented artifact placeholders).

构造从APIGen-MT对话开始。GPT-4.1推导用户specification和ground-truth tool call；在零售任务中，合成指令与难化改写版本各以50%概率选用。最终训练集包含约3,000个零售任务。mixed-task RL还选用中等难度、整数答案的DeepScaleR题目；作者此前比较过GSM8K、DeepScaleR与DAPO-MATH-17K。精确任务ID、各构造阶段保留数量和DeepScaleR样本数均为unknown（论文§3.1、§4.1；附录“Training Data”）。

sandbox以tau-bench seed data为起点，使用包含Products、Orders和Users的SQLite backend。REST endpoint注册为MCP tool。GPT-4 ReAct user simulator生成文本轮次；语音episode中，SeedTTS把这些回复转换为audio。agent在推理/tool-call序列与用户或工具observation之间交替，直到出现##STOP##或达到30轮上限（论文§2.1、Fig. 2；§2.2）。

规则式terminal verifier检查成功的写操作，并将tool-call参数与ground-truth annotation比较。完全匹配时R(tau)=1，任何不匹配均为0。随后TARL让GPT-4.1依据policy、任务指令、ground-truth call和完整带标签对话为每轮评分。terminal success使用10×权重，唯一的重大-1使用5×权重，其余turn score按1/T归一化，使正向process贡献上限为5。论文把总分划为perfect 15、good 10–15、good-attempt 0–5和failed -5–0（论文§3.2；附录judge prompt）。

文本policy为Qwen3-8B，文本训练在零售任务与DeepScaleR数学任务之间交替。语音policy为Qwen2.5-Omni-7B；它不先做SFT，而是在指令更明确的简化任务上进行30步GRPO warm-up，然后在数学、纯文本零售及语音用户零售batch间交替。batch size为128，由32个任务、每个任务4条rollout组成。报告设置还包括temperature 0.7、top-p 0.95、prompt length 4096、response length 1024、actor learning rate 1e-6、critic learning rate 1e-5，训练通常在200–300步后plateau（论文§4.1、§4.3；附录“Training Details”，表tab:hyperparameters）。

训练使用verl与RL-Factory，并比较GRPO、PPO和RLOO。把turn reward直接放到每轮最后一个token会使PPO不稳定；最佳版本将TARL求和为trajectory reward，在policy token上分配，并mask environment token。复现必须固定SQLite seed/database状态、REST与MCP schema、GPT-4/GPT-4.1和SeedTTS版本、prompt、split manifest、随机seed与rollout保留规则。当前没有链接任何对应的论文专属实现artifact（论文§2.2、§3.2、§5.1；paper.tex中被注释的artifact placeholder）。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On tau-bench retail, Table tab::main_results reports pass^1 of 42.6 for base Qwen3-8B, 51.3 for Qwen3-8B + GRPO, and 57.4 for +Math+TARL; the last comparison is 6.1 percentage points above GRPO under the reported setup (paper §4.2). These are author-reported task-success results using the primary verifier without tau-bench's expected-output check.

The multimodal table reports that base Qwen2.5-Omni-7B obtains 7.8 text pass^1 and 14.8 speech pass^1, while +GRPO+Math+TARL obtains 36.5 and 37.4. A policy trained without speech obtains 32.2 on speech evaluation versus 37.4 for mixed speech-text training; the authors interpret this gap as evidence that text-only fine-tuning erodes speech capability (paper §4.3–§4.4, Table tab::multimodal_results).

The reward-granularity analysis reports that trajectory-level aggregation improves pass^1 by 4.3 points over vanilla PPO, whereas direct turn-level reward assignment performs worse and destabilizes training (paper §5.1, Fig. reward_granularity; Table 2). An online-intervention variant allowing up to two judge interventions per reasoning step increases KL, destabilizes optimization, and does not improve performance (paper §5.2, Fig. intervention_comparison).

The negative generalization result is equally important: policies trained only on about 3,000 retail tasks deteriorate faster on airline evaluation as k increases, and the authors conclude that learned exploration does not transfer effectively (paper §2.3, Table tab::baseline_rl_results). These results show behavior under the paper's sandbox, reward, curriculum, and evaluation boundaries; they do not establish that the unreleased tasks or rollouts are high-quality reusable data, and no independent reproduction is reported.

在tau-bench retail上，表tab::main_results报告：base Qwen3-8B的pass^1为42.6，Qwen3-8B + GRPO为51.3，+Math+TARL为57.4；按表中数字，最后一项比GRPO高6.1个百分点（论文§4.2）。这些是作者在主要verifier设置下报告的任务成功结果，该设置不包含tau-bench的expected-output check。

多模态表报告：base Qwen2.5-Omni-7B的文本pass^1为7.8、语音pass^1为14.8，而+GRPO+Math+TARL分别达到36.5和37.4。未使用语音训练的policy在语音评测上得到32.2，而混合语音-文本训练得到37.4；作者把这一差距解释为纯文本fine-tuning会削弱语音能力的证据（论文§4.3–§4.4，表tab::multimodal_results）。

reward granularity分析报告，trajectory-level聚合比vanilla PPO的pass^1高4.3个百分点，而直接逐轮分配reward表现更差并使训练不稳定（论文§5.1，Fig. reward_granularity；表2）。另一种online intervention方案允许judge在每个推理step最多干预两次，但会提高KL、破坏优化稳定性，且没有改善表现（论文§5.2，Fig. intervention_comparison）。

负面的泛化结果同样重要：只在约3,000个零售任务上训练的policy，在airline评测中会随k增大而更快退化；作者据此认为学到的探索方式不能有效迁移（论文§2.3，表tab::baseline_rl_results）。这些结果只说明模型在论文sandbox、reward、curriculum与评测边界内的行为；它们不能证明未发布任务或rollout是高质量可复用数据，论文也未报告独立复现。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest baseline is long-horizon tool-use RL driven by a sparse environment success signal, including tau-bench-style terminal verification. Existing process-reward work can localize errors, but this paper applies localization to simulated user/tool conversations and anchors the judge with the hidden user instruction and ground-truth call trajectory (paper §2; §3.2).

The concrete change is a two-channel feedback interface: executable database state changes provide a rule terminal result, while GPT-4.1 provides {-1,0,1} turn adjudication; a fixed 10×/5×/1/T aggregation converts both into the reward used for online agent RL. The paper also carries this interface from Qwen3-8B text training to Qwen2.5-Omni-7B speech-text interaction through SeedTTS and a 30-step GRPO curriculum warm-up (paper §3.2; §4.3).

The useful direction signal is not merely “process supervision”: it is the distinction between where feedback is authored and where optimization consumes it. Turn-level labels exist, but the stable training recipe uses their episode-level sum. This makes reward granularity an explicit ablation axis for trajectory-data research and exposes a failure case for naive token-local reward assignment (paper §5.1).

The upstream pieces are not new: tau-bench seed data, SQLite, REST, MCP, GPT user simulation, SeedTTS, Qwen models, verl, RL-Factory, GRPO/PPO/RLOO, APIGen-MT, and DeepScaleR are reused or integrated. Scale and benchmark gains alone do not establish a reusable release. Before reuse, verify the promised paper-specific sandbox, exact tasks, task splits, rollout logs, checkpoints, environment snapshots, and licenses.

最接近的基线是由稀疏environment success驱动的长时程工具使用RL，包括tau-bench式terminal verification。已有process reward工作能够定位错误，但本文把定位用于模拟用户/工具对话，并让judge以隐藏用户指令和ground-truth call trajectory为锚点（论文§2、§3.2）。

具体变化是一个双通道反馈接口：可执行的数据库状态变化提供规则终局结果，GPT-4.1提供{-1,0,1}逐轮判断；固定的10×/5×/1/T聚合再把两者变成online agent RL实际使用的reward。论文还通过SeedTTS与30步GRPO curriculum warm-up，把该接口从Qwen3-8B文本训练扩展到Qwen2.5-Omni-7B语音-文本交互（论文§3.2、§4.3）。

该工作的方向意义不只是“process supervision”，而是区分反馈在哪里生成、优化器又在哪里消费它。逐轮label确实存在，但稳定训练配方使用其episode-level总和。这使reward granularity成为trajectory data研究中明确的ablation维度，也展示了简单token-local reward分配的失败案例（论文§5.1）。

上游组件并非本文新贡献：tau-bench seed data、SQLite、REST、MCP、GPT user simulation、SeedTTS、Qwen模型、verl、RL-Factory、GRPO/PPO/RLOO、APIGen-MT和DeepScaleR都是复用或集成。规模与benchmark增益本身不能建立可复用发布。复用前仍需核验论文承诺的专属sandbox、精确任务、任务split、rollout日志、checkpoint、环境snapshot与license。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• No official paper-specific code, sandbox, task set, rollout corpus, checkpoint, model card, or project page was verified. The experiments say the curated tasks and ground-truth calls “will” be open-sourced, and paper.tex leaves commented placeholders such as Code: To be; code, data, project, and model links therefore remain null.
  • The rule verifier checks successful database-changing calls against ground truth but omits tau-bench's phrasing-sensitive expected-output check. A trajectory can satisfy the write predicate while giving an incomplete, misleading, or otherwise poor conversational response (paper §2.1; appendix output-check tables).
  • GPT-4.1 adjudication has no disclosed model snapshot, temperature, calibration, inter-judge agreement, or cost. Allowing only one -1 per trajectory can under-penalize multiple major deviations, while later errors may receive only 0 (Appendix “LLM Judge Setup for Turn-Level Evaluation”).
  • Stable GRPO/PPO consumes an aggregate trajectory scalar rather than a truly local process reward. Direct turn-final-token assignment was unstable, so the reported method does not show that each judged turn receives reliable local credit (paper §3.2; §5.1).
  • Training is retail-only, tau-bench covers only two domains, and airline generalization is weak. Exact split manifests, APIGen-MT/tau-bench overlap checks, task deduplication, decontamination, successful/failed rollout retention, database hashes, hardware, compute hours, seeds, variance, and checkpoint selection are unknown.
  • Speech evaluation changes the task by removing authentication and directly providing the user profile because TTS makes name_number identifiers error-prone. Its scores are therefore not directly comparable to an otherwise identical text protocol (paper §4.3–§4.4).

• 尚未核验到论文专属的官方code、sandbox、任务集、rollout corpus、checkpoint、model card或project page。实验部分只说整理后的任务与ground-truth call“will”开源，paper.tex还保留Code: To be等被注释的placeholder；因此code、data、project与model链接均保持null。
  • 规则verifier只对照ground truth检查成功的数据库写调用，却省略tau-bench中对措辞敏感的expected-output check。trajectory即使满足写操作谓词，也可能给出不完整、误导或其他低质量的对话回复（论文§2.1；附录output-check表）。
  • GPT-4.1 adjudication没有披露模型snapshot、temperature、校准、judge间一致性或成本。每条trajectory最多只允许一个-1，可能不足以惩罚多个重大偏离；后续错误也可能只得到0（附录“LLM Judge Setup for Turn-Level Evaluation”）。
  • 稳定的GRPO/PPO消费聚合trajectory scalar，而不是真正局部的process reward。直接在每轮最后一个token上赋值不稳定，因此报告方法并未证明每个被判断的turn都获得可靠局部credit（论文§3.2、§5.1）。
  • 训练仅使用零售任务，tau-bench只有两个domain，向airline的泛化较弱。精确split manifest、APIGen-MT/tau-bench overlap检查、任务去重、decontamination、成功/失败rollout保留、数据库hash、hardware、compute hour、seed、variance和checkpoint选择均为unknown。
  • 由于TTS难以准确处理name_number标识符，语音评测移除了authentication并直接提供user profile，从而改变了任务；其分数不能与其他条件完全相同的文本protocol直接比较（论文§4.3–§4.4）。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, the paper is a concrete recipe for representing an episode as interleaved policy and environment sequences with task provenance, tool observations, simulated-user turns, per-turn judgments, terminal state-change verification, and an aggregated training reward. A new agent-RL pipeline can use that schema as a logging checklist even before reproducing TARL.

The method supports controlled experiments on reward granularity: terminal-only RL, direct turn-local placement, trajectory aggregation, and online judge intervention can be compared while keeping the environment and rollout policy fixed. The text/math mixture and the 30-step simplified-task GRPO warm-up also provide ablation targets for curriculum design, while the text-only versus speech-text result motivates modality-retention checks.

For audit, preserve the APIGen-MT source trajectory, synthesized and rewritten instructions, ground-truth calls, SQLite seed and mutations, REST/MCP schema, full conversation, GPT-4/GPT-4.1/SeedTTS versions, every {-1,0,1} turn score, terminal predicate output, aggregation result, failure status, and environment reset/replay identifiers. This record shape makes judge errors, verifier blind spots, reward hacking, overlap, and dropped failures inspectable.

Reuse class is reading/audit and recipe reference only. Direct training reuse is blocked until an official task/rollout release, executable sandbox, immutable environment and split manifests, licenses, and successful/failed sample retention are verified. The reported pass^1 gains do not remove those blockers.

对environment_agent_trajectory_data而言，该论文提供了具体episode配方：把policy与environment序列交错记录，并保留任务provenance、工具observation、模拟用户轮次、逐轮判断、终局状态变化验证和聚合训练reward。即使尚未复现TARL，新agent RL管线也可把这一schema作为日志清单。

该方法支持reward granularity对照：在环境和rollout policy保持不变时，比较terminal-only RL、直接turn-local赋值、trajectory聚合与online judge intervention。文本/数学混合及30步简化任务GRPO warm-up也可作为curriculum design的ablation对象；纯文本与语音-文本结果则可用于设计modality retention检查。

审计时应保留APIGen-MT源trajectory、合成与改写指令、ground-truth call、SQLite seed和mutation、REST/MCP schema、完整对话、GPT-4/GPT-4.1/SeedTTS版本、每个{-1,0,1}逐轮分数、terminal predicate输出、聚合结果、失败状态及环境reset/replay标识。该记录形状使judge错误、verifier盲区、reward hacking、数据overlap和被丢弃失败可被检查。

复用等级为reading/audit与recipe reference only。在官方任务/rollout发布、可执行sandbox、不可变环境与split manifest、license，以及成功/失败样本保留得到核验前，直接训练复用保持blocked。论文报告的pass^1提升不能消除这些阻碍。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with §2.1 and Fig. 2: SQLite seeded from tau-bench, REST endpoints exposed as MCP tools, GPT-4 user simulation, SeedTTS speech, and a rule terminal verifier form one environment contract.
  • TARL's judge labels turns {-1,0,1}, but the stable GRPO/PPO variants optimize the 10×/5×/1/T aggregated trajectory reward rather than independent local rewards (§3.2; §5.1).
  • The training recipe uses about 3,000 retail tasks, alternates text retail with DeepScaleR math, and gives Qwen2.5-Omni-7B a 30-step simplified-task GRPO warm-up before mixed speech-text training (§4.1; §4.3).
  • Read Table tab::main_results, Table tab::multimodal_results, and the reward-granularity/intervention analyses together; positive pass^1 results coexist with unstable local rewards, failed intervention, and weak airline transfer.
  • The expected natural-language output check is excluded from primary training/evaluation, so a correct database mutation does not certify conversational quality (§2.1; appendix output-check tables).
  • The paper promises future task release but provides no verified paper-specific code, data, project, rollout, or model artifact; training reuse remains blocked.

• 先读§2.1与Fig. 2：由tau-bench填充的SQLite、作为MCP tool暴露的REST endpoint、GPT-4 user simulation、SeedTTS语音和规则terminal verifier共同构成一个environment contract。
  • TARL的judge用{-1,0,1}标注每轮，但稳定GRPO/PPO实际优化10×/5×/1/T聚合后的trajectory reward，而不是彼此独立的局部reward（§3.2、§5.1）。
  • 训练配方使用约3,000个零售任务，在文本零售与DeepScaleR数学之间交替，并让Qwen2.5-Omni-7B先做30步简化任务GRPO warm-up，再进行混合语音-文本训练（§4.1、§4.3）。
  • 应把表tab::main_results、表tab::multimodal_results和reward-granularity/intervention分析合并阅读；正向pass^1结果与局部reward不稳定、intervention失败和airline迁移较弱同时存在。
  • 主要训练/评测排除了expected natural-language output check，因此数据库mutation正确并不能认证对话质量（§2.1；附录output-check表）。
  • 论文承诺未来发布任务，但没有已核验的论文专属code、data、project、rollout或model artifact；训练复用保持blocked。
